However, for strict auditing, if the feature isn't there, it's not present. I agree with the 'false' status but note that this is due to cropping, not anatomical absence. The softening of the spine tips against the black background is also a common generative blur/fusion artifact. The severity ratings are appropriate; they are noticeable but do not destroy the overall recognition of the animal.
